data.gender_notes: Khimrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Khawr', meaning 'pond' or 'meadow', and 'Khimar', meaning 'green'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes growth, renewal, and the beauty of nature. The name Khimrah carries the meaning “Green Meadow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khimrah usually hope their child will grow to embody green meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
